dimensions.description: Character, scene, palette, silhouette, and prop identity remain faithful to the reference image.
Requested action, composition, lighting, and shot language are present without contradictory content.
Faces, limbs, objects, textures, and lighting remain coherent across frames without flicker or morphing.
Subject motion and camera motion are smooth, physically readable, and match the prompt.
No duplicate subjects or props, malformed anatomy, text/watermark leakage, frame corruption, or severe compression artifacts.

gate_note: FLO-110 records quality observations but does not freeze a cross-project quality threshold; FLO-109 owns the gold-set scoring threshold and release gate.
